string-array.name: whats_new_highlights
string-array.item: Android Home Screen Glance Widget with dynamic opacity, theme modes (Light, Dark, Glass), and shape radiuses
Multi-select Goal Switches with All Goals master toggle for customizable widget filtering
Precise Time Toggle (Show precise time eg. 1h 15m vs 1.25 hrs decimal mode)
Visual Pinned Star Badge overlay on circular goal icon containers
Dynamic Light and Dark Launcher Widget preview matching system themes
Performance optimizations, bug fixes, and Material 3 Expressive UI polish
